description: Angular component for displaying detailed information about a recipe, including fetching recipe data by ID, handling image errors, and navigation.

classes.name: RecipeDetailComponent
classes.description: Angular component class managing the recipe detail view, fetching recipe data, handling images and navigation.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the component, fetches recipe data based on route parameter 'id', and handles error states.

methods.name: onImgError
methods.description: Handles the error event for the recipe image, substituting a fallback image.

methods.name: goBack
methods.description: Navigates back to the main page.

methods.name: toggleIngredient
methods.description: Toggles the checked state of an ingredient.
